text:
marco: FYI MetricWave trial ends Friday. Procurement asked for a final billing clarity pass before we commit. Can someone pull the sanitized invoice and flag anything that won't map cleanly to our billing ingestion ETL?
anya: I exported the trial invoice. There's an odd "init fee" and two vector line items: ingest vs query.
devin: Paste the sanitized lines pls. We need to decide how to tag these to our SKUs.
anya: Here you go (sanitized):
```
METRICWAVE INIT-FEE: 1 account @ $250 = $250.00
METRICWAVE INGEST-VECTORS: 12,000 vectors @ $0.0018/vector = $21.60
METRICWAVE QUERY-VECTORS: 2,400 vectors @ $0.0028/vector = $6.72
METRICWAVE TOKEN-REQUESTS: 320,400 tokens @ $0.00085/token = $272.34
METRICWAVE STREAM-INIT: 48 streams @ $0.50/stream = $24.00
REGIONAL SURCHARGE (APAC): $12.00
TOTAL = $586.66
```
hannah: The ingest vs query split is new for us. Procurement will want a boolean field showing whether a line counts toward the commit minimum. Also need a SKU id to map to cost centers.
oliver (MetricWave): Hi team 1: Thanks for the details. Quick context: ingest vectors are charged for indexing work; query vectors are for retrieval queries. We can provide a CSV with sku_id, description, unit, unit_price, counts_toward_commit (yes/no). We can also tag invoice lines with a cost_center free-text field if you send us the mapping.
marco: Can you confirm billing terms? We usually do Net45 for partners with small deals. Our default PO policy requires Net45 for non-SOW services under $150k.
oliver (MetricWave): We support PO numbers and Net30 by default. Net45 is fine for signed 12mo commitments >= $40k. For smaller deals we can do Net45 with a 1.5% finance fee.
devin: Discount math? If we do 12 months and commit to $90k/yr what discount can we expect?
oliver (MetricWave): Standard tiers: 12% off list for 12mo >= $75k, 18% off for >= $200k, 28% off for >= $400k. Commit billed monthly with quarterly true-ups. Unused committed spend is credited at year-end as invoice credits (no cash refunds).
anya: Tokenization alignment: our tokenizer shows ~5% fewer tokens than your counts on a sampled corpus. Will you sign a reconciliation addendum to accept our counts for billing?
oliver (MetricWave): We use a BPE tokenizer similar to GPT. We can provide a tokenization script and sample outputs. We do offer an addendum to accept Redwood's token counts as authoritative for billing, but that requires a 1-business-day reconciliation SLA and an initial audit. We'll draft that for legal review.
hannah: Trial credits? We used $2k trial credits. Do those apply to commit MRR or act as a one-time credit?
oliver (MetricWave): Trial credits are one-time invoice credits applied at conversion. They don't reduce the commit minimum calculation, but they will be applied before you pay the first invoice.
marco: Tax handling for EU customers? Reverse-charge?
oliver (MetricWave): For EU customers with valid VAT IDs we apply reverse-charge and include VAT ID fields on the invoice. For others we charge local VAT. We'll include a tax_summary block on every invoice.
finance-bot: Note: vendor risk questionnaire outstanding: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/risk/metricwave Assigned to @hannah and @legal. Due in 6 days.
devin: Billing export format - can you provide a machine-readable export? Our ingestion pipeline prefers gzipped NDJSON events or a CSV with these columns: invoice_date, sku_id, qty, unit_price, currency, cost_center, counts_toward_commit.
oliver (MetricWave): We support both. We'll deliver a gzipped NDJSON webhook for near-real-time usage and a monthly CSV invoice export. CSV will include sku_id and counts_toward_commit flags. We can also provide JSON-LD price manifests upon request.
anya: Any support for hard caps to prevent surprise bills? We want automatic soft alerts at 80/90% and an optional hard cap that returns 429s.
oliver (MetricWave): Soft alerts + email/webhook are standard. Hard caps can be enabled but are handled per-account and may cause degraded UX. We can enable a soft-fail mode where requests are queued instead of dropped.
hannah: SLA for hosted vs dedicated? Also key management for dedicated customers.
oliver (MetricWave): Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA. Dedicated: 99.95% and we support customer KMS for encryption at rest. We can host in eu-west-1 for EU data residency and provide SOC2 Type II artifacts under NDA.
marco: Any regional pricing surcharges or currency constraints? Our finance team needs currency granularity for EUR invoices.
oliver (MetricWave): We invoice in USD by default; EUR invoicing available for EU customers with a EUR price list. Regional surcharges are listed as separate invoice line items and will be included in the CSV.
devin: Ok next steps: @oliver please upload the CSV price sheet with sku_ids and counts_toward_commit column, attach tokenization script and a short reconciliation addendum draft, and confirm PO + Net45 terms in writing if we commit >= $40k. @hannah and @marco we'll get the vendor risk + SOC2 request kicked off. If we get the CSV and addendum today, I'll run a cost projection against last 60 days and post results here before EOD tomorrow.
oliver (MetricWave): Will upload CSV + script today and send a preliminary quote showing the 12mo 12% discounted tier. Happy to jump on a 20m call if you want to walk through the CSV.
marco: Thanks all. If the reconciliation addendum is acceptable we can wire up the ingestion and avoid manual fixes during renewal.
